entities.name: Oysters
entities.description: Marine bivalve mollusks, some of which produce pearls; they exist on Bloomburrow and Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: Plane where oysters exist and Otterfolk collect their pearls.

entities.name: Otterfolk
entities.description: Bloomburrow people who collect oyster pearls.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane known to have giant underwater oysters.
